target_reason: Current general-availability announcement; its own quote contains the earlier beta demo. Quoting the beta post would misidentify the current announcement.
text:
GPT-7 this year? One Decisions API demo says 21%. Apparently even AI is managing its expectations. 😄

The API is now generally available for fast probabilities, choices, and scores—useful for routing requests or deciding when an agent should ask for help. The 21% is a demo result, not an official release forecast. Decision quality still needs testing on the inputs your app will actually see.
